description: Fetch a best-execution quote from the chain's Ophis orderbook (use a chainId from list_chains' `tradeable`). Amounts are in atoms (smallest unit, uint256 decimal string). For kind='sell' the amount is the sell amount before fee; for kind='buy' it is the desired buy amount. Returns the orderbook quote (sellAmount/buyAmount/feeAmount/validTo). Before build_order, apply slippage to the limit side by kind: kind='sell' -> lower buyAmount (min out); kind='buy' -> raise sellAmount (max in).

chainId.description: EVM chain id (use list_chains for supported chains).

from.description: The trading account address (quotes are account-aware).

isStablePair.description: Optional assertion checked against the server-owned stablecoin registry; omit to auto-classify.

kind.description: 'sell' = you specify the sell amount; 'buy' = you specify the buy amount.

validForSeconds.description: Quote validity window in seconds (default 1200 = 20 min).

name: get_quote
